thesis: The speakers argue that investors should focus on process rather than outcome, noting that the time required to validate a process depends on the skill-to-luck ratio and the robustness of the underlying analytical and organizational systems. Additionally, the discussion introduces a four-part taxonomy of investment edges—behavioral, analytical, informational, and technical—while emphasizing that possessing an edge is distinct from the ability to monetize it efficiently.
